div.head: II Cn 44.1
div.ab: ⁊ gif him hwa wyrne, gebete þæt wið þone cing mid CXX scyll'; oðþe geladige [hine]: nime V ⁊ beo sylf syxta.
⁊ gif him hwa weorne, bete þæt wið cyningc mid hundtwentigum scyll'; oððe geladige hine: nime fif ⁊ beo sylf sixta.
Et si quis ei perneget, emendet regi CXX solidis; aut (uel) se adlegiet: sumat V et idem sit sextus.
⁊ gyf him man wyrne, gebete þæt wið ðone kyningc mid hundtwentig scyllinga oððe geladige hine—nime V men ⁊ beo him sylf VI-ta.
And gif him hwa wyrne, gebete þæt wið þone cing mid CXX scyllingum; oðþe geladige hine: nime V and beo sylf syxta.
And if anyone refuses it to him, he shall make amends for it to the king by the payment of 120 shillings, or he shall clear himself. He shall select five men and be himself a sixth.

And if anyone denies him confession, he shall atone for that with a payment to the king of one hundred and twenty shillings; or he may exonerate himself: he may select five witnesses and himself be the sixth.
And if anyone does refuse it to him, he is to pay 120 shillings compensation to the king; or, to clear himself, he is to take five men and be himself the sixth.
Und wenn einer [sie] ihm weigert, büsse er das gegenüber dem König durch 120 Schill.; oder er schwöre sich rein: wähle fünf [Eideshelfer] und sei selbst Sechster [im Eide].
And if anyone refuses [it] him, let him pay the king 120 shillings in compensation for it; or let him clear himself: let him take five [oath-helpers] and be himself the sixth [in the oath].
div.note: G's ‘hine’ is written with the abbreviation ·N· in G and A. B and A's ‘hundtwentig(um)’ = 120.
V and: V men and B
